notes:
SUMMARY:
- Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood Hosted API for quick path, then moving to Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation.
- Primary scope: embeddings + semantic search for user-facing product search and internal knowledge retrieval.

RECENT ACTIVITY:
- 2025-01-20: Intro call (Jordan) — product overview, SLA expectations.
- 2025-01-29: Hosted API demo — basic embeddings + search integration with Pinecone. Fireflies FF-11092.
- 2025-02-02: Tech deep-dive with SE (Maya) — data pipeline, nightly batch job requirements, vector DB options (Pinecone / Weaviate / Milvus).
- 2025-02-05: Pricing discussion — rough committed capacity numbers, initial Dedicated sizing.

USE CASE / REQUIREMENTS (customer language & notes):
- Ingest: nightly batch ~50k new docs (parquet -> embeddings). Need low-cost bulk embedding path. "We push 50k docs nightly; can't have it take hours."
- Search QPS: target 150-250 QPS at 95th percentile for production search; tail latency SLO < 150ms.
- Embedding throughput: target 800-1,200 docs/min for batch window.
- Vector DB: currently prototyping with Pinecone; open to managed Weaviate or internal Milvus. Want Redwood to play nicely with existing vector store (prefers connector + batching helpers).
- Model policy: prefer open/model variants; want fallback routing (smaller/cheaper model) if Dedicated capacity hits limit.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, wants predictable per-month committed cost vs overage pricing.

SECURITY / COMPLIANCE:
- Required: SOC2, SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS for keys, retention controls, EU data residency for some customers.
- Legal: needs DPA + security FAQ answers. Legal review in progress (blocker).

POC PLAN / METRICS:
- POC 1 (hosted): proof of concept for embeddings + search integration. Completed basic index and relevance checks.
- POC 2 (dedicated): scheduled throughput run 2025-02-18 -> measure: embedding bulk throughput, search QPS sustained, 95p latencies, token/unit cost.
- Success criteria: sustain 200 QPS search with 95p latency < 150ms and nightly embed pipeline finish within 90 minutes; cost per 1M queries below threshold agreed in pricing deck.

INTEGRATIONS / TECH NOTES:
- Current infra: AWS (us-east-1), microservices in k8s, ETL jobs run on Airflow.
- Wants Redwood Dedicated to sit in VPC peering with their k8s cluster; concerned about egress costs and private link options.
- Would like SDK examples for batch embeddings + retry/backoff for large files.
- Interested in Optimize suggestions around batching/quantization to reduce per-token/unit cost.

QUOTES / CUSTOMER VIBE:
- "If Dedicated gives us predictable pricing and the batching tools to keep costs down, this is a green-light for production." — Head of Product
- Team is pragmatic: will accept slightly higher latency if cost predictability and reliability are assured.

NEXT STEPS / ACTION ITEMS:
- Deliver updated Dedicated pricing with committed throughput tiers (Jordan) — 2025-02-10.
- SE to run throughput POC with 200 QPS and nightly bulk embed (Maya) — scheduled 2025-02-18.
- Legal to complete DPA review (customer legal).
- Provide sample Airflow + SDK batch recipe and Pinecone connector doc (link in drive).

RISKS / OPEN QUESTIONS:
- How to price storage for vector DB when Redwood Dedicated used as inference + connectors to external vector stores?
- Network egress assumptions for VPC peered Dedicated clusters.
- If POC fails to hit 95p latency target, customer will push to alternate vendors (Algolia + custom infra).

TAGS / INTERNAL NOTES:
- Good fit for mid-market Dedicated motion. Strong buyer signals: committed POC, legal budget, Product exec involvement.
- Keep Optimize/quant suggestions high priority in POC to show cost delta.
- Jira follow-up: RED-1632 created for pricing clarification and VPC design.
